scientific_integrity: The unrestricted statements rest on the elementary coordinate proof. Finite exhaustive checking covers only the explicitly enumerated graphs. The mathematical review is not an independent audit, and no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only 2-plexes in Cartesian products of at least two complete graphs, each of order at least two. It does not require connected 2-plexes, and it does not assert a result for higher k. Published-source coverage and priority are provisional, and a prior Hamming-embedding source was only accessible in abstract.
title: All \(2\)-plexes of Cartesian products of complete graphs
